title: Sales/CS Signal Lattice: First-pass Feature Framing
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight, repeatable intake and rapid-framing flow for Sales/CS enterprise feature asks that are non-bug and non-contract. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-decision from days to <48h for initial scoping and to produce a single-page mini-PRD (customer problem, success metrics, three candidate solutions, ballpark cost/effort, recommended next step).

Scope: first-pass consolidation of incoming asks for a single account or cohort (up to 10 asks) into one decisionable artifact. This ticket defines the signal-lattice scoring approach, the mini-PRD template, and a handoff checklist for Eng/Design for deeper scoping.

Why now: Sales/CS volume has increased and PMs are spending >20% of their time doing first-pass sketchettes. This creates lag in enterprise negotiations and bloats roadmap noise. A rapid, repeatable pattern will free PM cycles and give Sales faster guidance.

Non-goals: Not designing final UX, not replacing full PRDs or discovery sprints. Not for regulatory or procurement requests (these require Legal/Compliance triage).

Deliverables: 1) Signal Lattice rubric (quantitative factors + thresholds); 2) One-page mini-PRD template (Google Drive link below); 3) Triage playbook (Slack + Zendesk capture points); 4) Pilot with Sales team on 5 accounts next two weeks.
triage_rubric: Signal Lattice factors: Impact (0-5), Implementation Complexity (0-5), Revenue Proximity (0-5), Strategic Fit (0-5), Time-to-value (0-5)
Scoring: sum -> 0-8 = Low priority (Backlog), 9-15 = Medium (Follow-up in next planning), 16-25 = High (Immediate PM review/candidate for roadmap or rapid spike)
Shortcuts: If Revenue Proximity >=4 and Impact >=4 -> auto-flag for Sales-supported discovery sync
Customer-cohort weight: apply x1.5 multiplier when requests come from enterprise accounts with ARR > $250k or strategic partners
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable mini-PRD template is published in Drive and linked from the Sales intake Slack workflow
Signal Lattice rubric documented and test-applied to 10 historical asks with labeled scores
Pilot run completed with Sales on 5 accounts and at least 3 resulting disposition decisions (Accept/Defer/Research)
Handoff checklist created for Eng/Design with initial effort bands and ownership assignments
initial_scope: Produce docs + Slack/Notion workflow + pilot. No engineering changes required unless pilot surfaces an immediate P0. Estimated PM effort: 3 pts. Design: 1 pt for template. Engineering: consultation only (0-1 pt).
effort_estimates: Design: 1 point (mini-PRD template + two example filled templates)
Eng: 1 point (feasibility consults for borderline high-impact asks)
risks_and_tradeoffs: Risk: Over-standardization could prematurely deprioritize subtle but strategic asks. Mitigation: keep a free-text 'strategic override' field and require a Sales justification for overrides.

Tradeoff: Faster triage reduces PM time but may increase Eng context-swapping if not paired with stronger 'research spike' thresholds. Mitigation: set a minimum complexity threshold (Implementation Complexity >=3) to require Eng spike approval.
Risk: Heavy reliance on Revenue Proximity may bias toward large accounts at the expense of product-market fit signals. Mitigation: track cohort outcomes separately during pilot.
